thread:
Tom Nguyen (Hiring Manager): Heads up — need to get an offer out to Samir Patel (Staff Infra) today. Candidate has a competing verbal at +15% vs our band midpoint and wants a start 2 weeks earlier than our standard window. Can we do a one-time pay elevation + sign-on split to land him?
Maya Ortiz - People Ops: Thanks Tom. Quick Qs: (1) current band and proposed base? (2) is this a relocation? (3) requested start date?
Tom Nguyen (Hiring Manager): Band = Band 6 L3, midpoint $220k. We were thinking $250k total comp: base $220k + one-time sign-on $30k (split 50/50 frontloaded). Start date requested = 2026-05-04 (our standard earliest is 2026-05-18). No relocation.
Maya Ortiz - People Ops: Noted. This is a >13% uplift on base. Per policy, any uplift >10% requires comp committee + finance signoff. Also early start (<2 weeks earlier than policy) needs manager + manager's manager ack and payroll gating. I'll kick off approvals flow.
Lara Kim (Recruiter): Candidate accepted verbal contingent on the $30k. He's moving quickly — recruiter deadline EOD today. Can we tag this as expedited?
Jules Carter (Comp & Benefits): FYI — raise to $220k base is at midpoint. The requested total comp is above midpoint but within competitive bounds. I can pre-review a rationale: critical hire, retention risk, market delta. If Finance approves sign-on split, comp committee will probably greenlight.
Maya Ortiz - People Ops: @approvals-bot starting routed approvals: comp-committee -> finance -> HR-payroll-gate -> people-ops final. Tagging reviewers: @Jules Carter, @Ravi Shah, @Maya Ortiz. Please respond with approve/deny and short reason.
approvals-bot: Approval request created: ID 0x7a3f. Details: Candidate Samir Patel; Role: Staff Infra Eng; Proposed: base $220k + $30k sign-on (50% upfront / 50% 6mo); Early start 2026-05-04; Expedited by hiring manager. Due: 2026-04-28 17:00 PT. Link: https://approvals.internal/0x7a3f
Ravi Shah (Finance): Quick calc — $30k sign-on (capex OPEX?) This is hire cost, FY26 run-rate impact minimal since split. Finance okay to approve one-time sign-on if manager confirms split and there is headcount budget. Need headcount code and budget owner ack.
Tom Nguyen (Hiring Manager): Headcount code: ENG-INFRA-2026-HC-12. Budget owner = Priya Rao (Eng Finance). I will ping Priya now.
Maya Ortiz - People Ops: For the early start we need written confirmation from Tom's manager (L4+) that backfill/pairing/training plan exists and compensation is recorded. Tom, please paste the manager approval here.
Tom Nguyen (Hiring Manager): @Priya Rao pinged — she replied approve in Slack DM and said budget available. Also pasted manager approval: "I (Anya Li) approve expedited start and the one-time split sign-on in light of candidate scarcity and cross-team impact."
Jules Carter (Comp & Benefits): Comp committee -> pre-approve conditionally. My note: approve subject to Finance final and payroll gating for split payment schedule.
Ravi Shah (Finance): Finance approved. Verified budget code and one-time sign-on accounting.
approvals-bot: Approval update: comp-committee APPROVED by Jules Carter; finance APPROVED by Ravi Shah; HR-Payroll PENDING.
Maya Ortiz - People Ops: Lara — HR/payroll needs candidate SSN + bank details and start date to setup split payment. Also need offer letter language confirming sign-on schedule and clawback if candidate leaves before 6 months. Can you provision the candidate docs and route to payroll?
Lara Kim (Recruiter): On it. I will attach SSN form + bank info to the approvals thread and draft offer language. Will send to payroll in next 30 min.
Maya Ortiz - People Ops: Great. Once payroll confirms split schedule, People Ops will finalize the offer and Tom can extend. Please mark this thread as 'expedited' in the approvals UI.
Tom Nguyen (Hiring Manager): Thanks team — I'll hold on outreach until payroll confirms. Appreciate the fast turnaround. :raised_hands:
Maya Ortiz - People Ops: Final note: Document rationale in Greenhouse notes and tag comp-committee decision. This protects audit trail. Closing loop once payroll confirms disbursement dates.
approvals-bot: Approval update: HR-Payroll APPROVED. Offer cleared to send.
Lara Kim (Recruiter): Offer emailed to candidate with 50% sign-on at start, 50% at 6 months, clawback terms included. Candidate accepted verbal, will sign by EOD tomorrow.
Tom Nguyen (Hiring Manager): Wonderful. Thanks everyone. Closing thread.
